record.question: Alberto Fernandez recently won the presidential election of which country?
record.explanation: Answer C: Argentina. Argentina’s National Congress proclaimed the ticket of Alberto Fernández and Cristina Fernández de Kirchner elected after validating the 27 October 2019 election result. Reference: https://www.hcdn.gob.ar/prensa/noticia/LA-ASAMBLEA-LEGISLATIVA-PROCLAMO-AL-PRESIDENTE-Y-A-LA-VICEPRESIDENTA-ELECTOS/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
